name: 6-MeO-isoDMT
summary: 6-MeO-isoDMT, or 6-OMe-isoDMT, also known as 6-methoxy-N,N-dimethylisotryptamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, prospective serotonergic psychedelic, and psychoplastogen of the isotryptamine group. It is the isotryptamine analogue of the psychedelic 5-MeO-DMT and is a positional isomer of the non-hallucinogenic psychoplastogen 5-MeO-isoDMT.

pharmacology.text: 6-MeO-isoDMT, or 6-OMe-isoDMT, also known as 6-methoxy-N,N-dimethylisotryptamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, prospective serotonergic psychedelic, and psychoplastogen of the isotryptamine group.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Psychoplastogen

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a possible antidepressant that promotes the growth of nerve connections.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被當作可能的抗憂鬱藥來研究，作用是促進神經連結生長。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被当作可能的抗忧郁药来研究，作用是促进神经链接生长。

fact.en: In isotryptamines the side chain hangs from a different carbon of the indole ring than in ordinary tryptamines, which is enough to change whether a drug causes hallucinations.
fact.zh: 在異色胺中，側鏈接在吲哚環上與一般色胺不同的碳上，而光是這點差異，就足以改變藥物會不會引起幻覺。
fact.zhHans: 在异色胺中，侧链接在吲哚环上与一般色胺不同的碳上，而光是这点差异，就足以改变药物会不会引起幻觉。
